calibration_packet.description: Structured re-statement of the 10-code failure_reasons vocabulary, set-match scoring rules, and primary_failure_code selection rules for the envelope-sequence audit task

canonical_answer.derivation_summary: 1 inspection of Mixed-labeled envelope to identify its pure type + 14 same-type observations to force distinction against 7/13 mixed envelope worst case

codes.triggering_condition: Response states any numeric answer other than 15 as the minimum inspections required

codes.definition: Response oscillates among incompatible counts without committing
codes.triggering_condition: Multiple conflicting numeric answers proposed; answer vacillates (e.g., 2, 3, 14, 15); final commitment differs from earlier claims without clear resolution logic
example_patterns: I think 3... Wait... Actually maybe 2... Final answer: 3

codes.definition: Closing synthesis step is hand-wavy or lacks branch-by-branch label-fixing rule
codes.triggering_condition: Response substitutes abstract reasoning (information theory, entropy) for concrete inspection strategy; no explicit statement of which envelopes to inspect, in what order, what conclusions to draw per outcome; 'deduce' or 'determined' without specifying how
example_patterns: at this point the remaining are determined

codes.definition: Proposed strategy's upper-bound proof fails in some worst-case branch
codes.triggering_condition: Strategy does not achieve guaranteed correct labeling in all branches; some branch leaves ambiguity unresolved; verification threshold insufficient to distinguish pure from mixed

codes.definition: No impossibility proof for fewer-than-claimed inspections
codes.triggering_condition: Response asserts minimality but only justifies count of its own strategy; lacks indistinguishable-case argument showing no alternative strategy with fewer inspections can succeed
example_patterns: this is optimal because my strategy uses N inspections
minimum is N because I can solve it in N

codes.definition: Strategy treats favorable single-draw observations as resolving worst-case ambiguity
codes.triggering_condition: Analysis assumes best-case outcomes (first draw reveals minority type); fails to account for branch where mixed envelope returns same type as pure envelope on initial draws
example_patterns: inspect one from each envelope to determine their types
if we see increasing, that envelope is increasing

codes.definition: Claims one observed sequence from an envelope that could still be mixed proves the envelope is pure
codes.triggering_condition: Response infers an envelope's pure category from single observation without multi-draw verification ruling out 7/13 mixed case; treats first observation as definitive proof
example_patterns: inspect one from Mixed envelope... it must be strictly increasing
if first draw is increasing, envelope is increasing

codes.definition: Response adds inspections solely to determine exact 2-type composition of the mixed envelope
codes.triggering_condition: Strategy includes additional inspections beyond what is needed for guaranteed relabeling; attempts to identify both types in mixed envelope rather than just identifying one envelope as pure to force the rest by derangement logic
example_patterns: need to find which 7 and which 13
must determine both types in mixed envelope

codes.definition: Load-bearing 'forced by contradiction', 'remaining are determined', 'cycle uniquely', or 'follow directly' assertion
codes.triggering_condition: Response contains a categorical claim that labels are forced/derived/determined without valid deductive support; elimination assertion ignoring derangement of 3 envelopes; 'automatically' without accounting for mixed envelope among remaining
example_patterns: remaining two envelopes are determined automatically by elimination

codes.definition: No committed final numeric answer at all; stands alone when present
codes.triggering_condition: Response declines to commit any finite number; appeals to objections outside problem structure; infinitely recursive reasoning; no boxed or bold final answer

exact_match.condition: failure_reasons set identical to oracle set (same codes, no extras, no omissions)

off_by_one_substantively_equivalent.condition: Sets differ by exactly one code, but the substantive analysis is equivalent (e.g., both capture same underlying defect)

overlap_50_percent.condition: Intersection size >= 50% of union; partial overlap with substantive divergence in analysis

primary_failure_code_selection_rules.requirement: Choose exactly ONE primary_failure_code per response
selection_criteria: Must be a code from the response's failure_reasons set, OR 'NONE' if failure_reasons is empty
Select the single most load-bearing diagnostic defect
The defect that most fundamentally undermines the response's correctness
Prefer: wrong_final_number if answer deviates from 15, unless reasoning is so incoherent that non_terminating_or_no_final_answer applies
Prefer: fatal_wrong_claim when response contains categorical elimination assertion that is mathematically invalid
Prefer: invalid_one_draw_inference when the core error is treating single observations as proof
Prefer: no_concrete_strategy when response lacks any inspection procedure
non_terminating_or_no_final_answer stands alone - if present, it is typically the primary code

code_application_count_rules.description: Integer equal to length of failure_reasons list
code_application_count_rules.empty_set: Use 0 when response has no failure reasons (correct answer with valid reasoning)

evidence_key_completeness_rules.description: Number of keys in failure_reason_evidence that are also in failure_reasons
evidence_key_completeness_rules.requirement: Every code in failure_reasons must have a corresponding evidence entry

universal_phrase_pattern_rules.rule_1: When response claims 'the remaining envelopes are determined/forced/unique' after N inspections where N < 15, and N observations do not actually force a unique labeling, apply fatal_wrong_claim
universal_phrase_pattern_rules.rule_2: When response claims 'inspect one sequence from each envelope' or treats first observation as definitive type identification, apply invalid_one_draw_inference AND not_worst_case
universal_phrase_pattern_rules.rule_3: When response uses information theory or entropy without concrete inspection steps, apply no_concrete_strategy
universal_phrase_pattern_rules.rule_4: When response oscillates between multiple numeric answers (e.g., 2, 3, 14, 15) without clear resolution, apply contradictory_final_answer
universal_phrase_pattern_rules.rule_5: When response asserts 'elimination' or 'by contradiction' without valid deductive support, apply fatal_wrong_claim
universal_phrase_pattern_rules.rule_6: When response states any number other than 15 as final answer, apply wrong_final_number
universal_phrase_pattern_rules.rule_7: When response admits it cannot determine answer or appeals outside problem structure, apply non_terminating_or_no_final_answer (stands alone)

borderline_resolution_rules.ambiguous_strategy: If strategy is vague but seems to imply correct count, prefer no_concrete_strategy over invalid_upper_bound
borderline_resolution_rules.partial_verification: If response mentions verification but with wrong threshold, apply invalid_upper_bound
borderline_resolution_rules.multiple_errors: Include all instantiated codes; do not truncate to single error
borderline_resolution_rules.substantive_equivalence: Two codes may overlap in practice (e.g., invalid_one_draw_inference and not_worst_case often co-occur); include both when both conditions are met
